infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Fimto uses the camera to scan encrypted delivery-ticket QR codes at project sites so drivers and clients can verify the correct load reached the correct project.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Fimto uses your location to record checkpoint arrivals and confirm you are inside the delivery-site geofence.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Fimto requires continuous background location for fleet telemetry, live ETA computation, speed analytics, and automated geofence triggering of the 7-checkpoint delivery timeline — even when the app is closed or not in use.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Fimto requires continuous background location for fleet telemetry and automated geofence checkpoints even when the app is closed.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Fimto requires continuous background location for fleet telemetry, live ETA, and automated geofence checkpoints even when the app is closed.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Fimto uses your location to record checkpoint arrivals at delivery sites.

plugins.cameraPermission: Fimto uses the camera to scan encrypted delivery-ticket QR codes at project sites.

plugins.microphonePermission: Fimto uses the microphone to let drivers record a short voice note about a vehicle breakdown.
